advisory.message_en: [Saa Wa? 2024] GMet expects the rains to start from the 4th week of April to the 2nd week of May, later than usual. A dry spell of 10 to 11 days may follow, so do not plant on the first rains. Rains should end from the 3rd week of October to the 1st week of November. Wait for steady rains before sowing.
